name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.1 days starting 2025-06-02, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
